## Checklist
- [ ] Source confirmed public and appropriate (no login/ToS bypass)
- [ ] Deduplication tested (re-runs, cross-source, manual posts)
- [ ] Low-confidence fields route to human review
- [ ] Location resolves via known places → geocoder → AI last resort
- [ ] Evals run against real saved examples and pass
- [ ] Safe to re-run/restart without losing state
